mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.`warn_time` ${timeFormat} ${timeFlag}, COUNT(1) AS totalNum, COUNT(t.deal_type) AS validNum FROM (SELECT deal_type, warn_time FROM t_warn_info UNION ALL (SELECT deal_type, defect_time warn_time FROM t_defect_info)) t WHERE t.warn_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} GROUP BY ${timeFlag} order by ${timeFlag}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.warn_time ${timeFormat} ${timeFlag}, count(1) as totalNum, sum(if(t.deal_type = 286, 1, 0)) as validNum FROM (select deal_type, warn_time from t_warn_info where deal_type is not null union all (select deal_type, defect_time warn_time from t_defect_info where deal_type is not null)) t where t.warn_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} group by ${timeFlag}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(detail.cruise_time ${timeFormat} ${timeFlag}, count(1) AS totalNum, SUM( IF ( detail.cruise_status = 252, 0, 1 ) ) AS validNum FROM u_patrol_task tct LEFT JOIN u_patrol_data_result detail ON detail.task_id = tct.task_id WHERE detail.cruise_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} GROUP BY ${timeFlag}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT( result.cruise_time ${timeFormat} ${timeFlag}, count(1) AS totalNum, count(result.identify_result) AS validNum FROM u_patrol_data_result result WHERE result.cruise_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} GROUP BY ${timeFlag}
